title: FIT File Reference Record
description: A structured record documenting the provenance and field schema of an analysed FIT activity file.

record_id.description: Stable unique identifier. Format: {manufacturer}-{product_slug}-{source_platform}-{source_type}-{sport}-{NNN}. See schema/vocabulary.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to.

provenance.description: Where the file came from. No PII — no coordinates, serial numbers, timestamps, or account-specific IDs.

platform.description: See vocabulary: garminconnect, strava, device, etc.

export_method.description: Human-readable description of the specific export path used

filename_pattern.description: The filename pattern used by this platform/source_type combination, with placeholders. E.g. '{activity_id}_ACTIVITY.fit'

zip_contents.description: Files present in the ZIP, with actual names replaced by pattern placeholders

devices.description: Devices recorded in device_info messages. No serial numbers or ANT IDs.

primary.description: The creator device — the watch or head unit that recorded the file.

garmin_product_id.description: Raw product integer from FIT file. Useful for programmatic device identification.

sensors.description: Additional devices and internal modules recorded in device_info.

device_type_raw.description: Raw integer when device_type cannot be decoded

activity.description: High-level activity summary. No timestamps or coordinates.

display_name.description: Value of session def_num 110 (Garmin activity display name)

message_types.description: All message types present in the file. Keys are message type names (unknown types use their raw number as 'unknown_N'). Values describe count and notes.

fields.description: Field presence by message type. Only record, session, and lap are required; other message types may be added.

def_num.description: Field definition number within this message type

name.description: fitparse field name, or 'unknown_N' if unrecognised

ffv_name.description: Name as shown by FitFileViewer, if different from fitparse name
